help.title: Help & Support
help.subtitle: Have questions or need assistance? We are here to help.
help.whatsappDesc: Get instant help and query resolution over WhatsApp chat.
help.callDesc: Speak to our customer support representative directly.
help.faq1Answer: MoneyLens is a secure, offline-first personal wealth manager designed to track transactions, simulate budgets, calculate financial health scores, manage family wallets, and more.
help.faq2Question: Where is my financial data stored?
help.faq2Answer: Your data is stored locally on your device for fast offline access. If you are signed in, it is automatically synchronized to a secure database in the cloud (Firebase Firestore).
help.faq3Answer: You can click the Microphone button in the workspace sidebar/tray and speak in Hindi, English, or Hinglish (e.g. 'मैंने ₹५०० खाने पर खर्च किये'). Our system will automatically parse the amount and category, then record it as a transaction.
help.faq4Question: What is the Financial Health Score?
help.faq4Answer: It is a 0-100 score computed based on your savings rate, budget discipline, consistency of logs, debt-to-income ratio, and spending stability.
help.faq5Question: How can I split bills with friends?
help.faq5Answer: Use the 'Bill Splitter' from the sidebar. You can input multiple expenses and our system will use an optimization algorithm to minimize the number of repayments.
help.faq6Question: How do I reset my data?
help.faq6Answer: Go to Settings and scroll down to the 'Purge & Reset All Data' section. Note that this action is permanent and cannot be undone.
